children.title: Thoughts on AI in software engineering
children.summary: AI amplifies engineering ability, making experience and judgment more important—not less—as teams build and maintain production systems.

children.title: Designing tools for interrupted teams
children.summary: The best internal tools absorb messy inputs, preserve context, and help people recover quickly after the day breaks apart.

children.title: Turning ambiguous asks into deliverable scope
children.summary: A small set of framing questions can reveal the user, constraint, and outcome hiding inside a scattered request.
